simple.meaning: חָשַׁךְ (châshak) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 18 times across Exodus, Job, Psalms, Ecclesiastes, Isaiah, and 5 more, beginning at Exodus 10:15. Its contexts include land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָשַׁךְ (H2821).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָשַׁךְ (châshak) / H2821 is traced through Exodus 10:15, Job 3:9, Job 18:6, Job 38:2 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
Let the stars of its twilight be dark.
The light will be dark in his tent.
Pour out your indignation on them.
He sent darkness, and made it dark.
even the darkness doesn’t hide from you,
Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened,
in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble,
They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea.
For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.
Give glory to Yahweh your God,
Their appearance is blacker than a coal.
For this our heart is faint.
At Tehaphnehes also the day will withdraw itself,
seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion,
It will happen in that day,” says the Lord Yahweh,
“Therefore night is over you, with no vision,

definitions.short: to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken
definitions.usage: be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide.
definitions.full: H2821. chashak חָשַׁךְ verb be, grow dark (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic חֲשַׁךְ , ; Arabic bear rancour , see Lag BN 30 ) — Qal Perfect ׳ח Isa 5:30 4 t.; וְחָֽשְׁכָה consecutive Micah 3:6 (but see below); חָֽשְׁכוּ Lam 5:17 ; וְחָֽשְׁכוּ consecutive Eccl 12:3 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular תֶּחְשַׁךְ 12:2 ; וַתֶּחְשַׁךְ Exod 10:15 ; 3 masculine plural יֶחְשְׁכוּ Job 3:9 ; 3 feminine plural תֶּחְשַׁכְנָה Psa 69:24 ; — 1 be, grow dark , אוֺר Isa 5:30 , compare (figurative) Job 18:6 ; הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ Isa 13:10 (figurative); היום Ezek 30:18 (where read חשׁך , for ᵑ0 Baer חשׂך ); Job 3:9 (subject כוכבים ), compare Eccl 12:2 (subject הכוכבים הירח, האור, השׁמשׁ, ); impersonal Micah 3:6 ; (si vera 1.; but read probably וַחֲשֵׁכָה , corresponding with לַיְלָה preceding). 2 have a dark colour: תָּֽאֳרָם ׳ח מִשְּׁחוֺר Lam 4:8 darker than blackness is their visage ; of the earth הָאֶרֶץ Exod 10:15 . 3 grow dim Lam 5:17 (subject עינינו ), compare Psa 69:24 (figurative), Eccl 12:3 subject הָראֹוֺת i.e. the eyes. Hiph`il Perfect הֶחְשִׁיךְ Amos 5:8 , וְהַחֲשַׁכְתִּ֫י 8:9 ; Imperfect יַחֲשִׁיךְ Psa 139:12 ; יַחְשִׁךְ Jer 13:16 ; וַיַּחְשִׁךְ Psa 105:28 ; Participle מַחְשִׁיךְ Job 38:2 ; — 1 make dark , הח לילה ׳יום Amos 5:8 ; absolute cause darkness Jer 13:16 ; Psa 105:28 , compare Amos 8:9 ( לארץ ). 2 = hide, conceal , followed by מִמֶּךָּ Psa 139:12 . 3 figurative obscure, confuse Job 38:2 (object עֵצָה ).
